name: yogascheduler
description: YogiTrack — a MERN scheduling app for a yoga studio manager to add instructors and schedule classes.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build: (cd server && npm run build) && (cd client && npm run build)
scripts.heroku-postbuild: (cd server && npm install --include=dev) && (cd client && npm install --include=dev) && npm run build
